issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) semantics differ subtly from resolve(s, from) and may break absolute sources
issues.detail: The change from resolve(s || '', from) to resolve(from, '..', s || '') changes how source paths are resolved. If 's' is an absolute path or a URL-like value, path.resolve will treat the absolute portion as the new root, which mostly works, but if 'from' is itself a URL (http:// or file://) rather than a filesystem path, prepending '..' and resolving will produce wrong paths. Worth verifying behavior for URL-style 'from' values.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside getSourceMap callback blocks the event loop per stack frame
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called per frame during stack parsing and does a synchronous readFileSync plus existsSync for every external file. For large stacks across many external modules this could noticeably stall reporting, and there is no caching across frames or across multiple errors in the same run. Memoizing by file path would be a cheap and safe win.

issues.description: No try/catch around readFileSync — a transient FS error will crash error reporting
issues.detail: existsSync followed by readFileSync is a TOCTOU race; the file can disappear or become unreadable between checks (e.g., during watch-mode rebuilds, network mounts, or permission changes). An EACCES/ENOENT thrown here will propagate out of parseErrorStacktrace and corrupt the very error pipeline that is trying to report a failure. Wrap in try/catch and fall back to undefined.

issues.description: convert-source-map added as a runtime dep but @types/convert-source-map is in dependencies, not devDependencies
issues.detail: Looking at the package.json hunk, @types/convert-source-map is added alongside the runtime convert-source-map entry. The diff context is ambiguous about which block this lands in, but @types/* packages should live in devDependencies. If this ended up in dependencies it bloats install size for every vitest consumer with type-only code.

issues.description: Returned '{}' fallback in createConvertSourceMapReadMap is a non-empty source map JSON that may confuse downstream consumers
issues.detail: Returning '{}' as a placeholder map is parsed as valid JSON by convertSourceMap but lacks required fields (version, mappings). Depending on the convert-source-map version's strictness this may throw downstream rather than silently no-op. A minimal valid empty sourcemap like '{"version":3,"sources":[],"mappings":""}' would be safer.

issues.description: Snapshot now reports .ts source positions, but transpiled.ts may not actually exist beside the .js in real installs
issues.detail: The updated snapshot expects transpiled.ts paths in the stack. If the published package only ships .js + inline sourcemap and not the original .ts, fromMapFileSource will fall back to '{}', leaving users with broken mappings in production node_modules even though the test fixture works. Worth confirming the fixture mirrors real publish layouts.

review.summary: The PR's core change in source-map.ts (resolve(from, '..', s)) is a reasonable fix for source path resolution but worth verifying against absolute/URL-style 'from' values. The bigger risks live in test-run.ts: the new getSourceMap callback does synchronous file I/O per stack frame with no caching and no try/catch, which can stall reporting or, worse, throw inside the error-reporting pipeline. The '{}' fallback for missing map files and the dependency placement of @types/convert-source-map deserve a second look. Snapshot updates assume original .ts files exist next to compiled .js in node_modules, which is fixture-specific and may not reflect typical published packages.
